evidence_items.publisher: arXiv; Rafael M. Batista and Thomas L. Griffiths
evidence_items.locator: Limitations and Future Directions, first paragraph
evidence_items.explanation: The study establishes a mechanism in a bounded task, not near-universal susceptibility. Its January preregistration and February publication place the experiment in 2026, but it is not a publication-date population measurement.

evidence_items.locator: Section 3, paragraph discussing robustness across participant traits
evidence_items.explanation: The preprint reports interpersonal-judgment effects that persist after accounting for participant characteristics, supporting concern beyond narrowly vulnerable users. These earlier sample findings do not establish essentially universal susceptibility on the target date.

unresolved_gaps: No located study establishes susceptibility across essentially all major chatbot-user groups.
Average treatment effects and adjustment for participant characteristics do not establish that nearly everyone is individually susceptible.
The sources do not provide a population measurement for March 3, 2026.
Exact collection dates for the interpersonal experiments were not established; e2 is contextual and dated only to the preprint year.
